scripts.prebuild: node -e "for (const path of ['dist', 'bundle']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run bundle:mcp && node scripts/export-tool-schemas.mjs && node scripts/release.mjs manifest
scripts.bundle:mcp: esbuild src/mcp.ts src/style-check.ts --bundle --splitting --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outdir=bundle --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --banner:js="import { createRequire as __fsCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; import { fileURLToPath as __fsFileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; import { dirname as __fsDirname } from 'node:path'; const require = __fsCreateRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = __fsFileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = __fsDirname(__filename);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix test/fixtures/frontend run acceptance && npm --prefix test/fixtures/frontend run test:e2e
